script: systems/vert/bolero_vacuity/run_in_container_fuzz_real.sh + check_fuzz_real.py (fuzz step); fuzz_real_classify.py (input re-check under the full UB rule, ledger lookup, assembly); startup_crash_diag.py (diagnostic, not counted)
purpose: issues.md item 1 / docs/reviews/code-review-2026-11-15.md A.1: results/vert_bolero_vacuity_current.json's fuzz_30s arm fuzzed a planted copy (plant(): f_gold -> return 12345). This run fuzzes VERT's REAL, unmodified out-rwasm-bolero projects with the same command for 30 s.
command: cd ~/work/arxiv-vertfuzz && docker run -d --name arxiv_vertfuzz --cpus=4 -e CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 -v "$PWD:/w" -w /w ubuntu:22.04@sha256:0a9887931b0e38af2e3487ed39e29436b0535c4f3f52e57745baaf79d1898956 sleep infinity; docker exec -e WORKERS=4 arxiv_vertfuzz bash systems/vert/bolero_vacuity/run_in_container_fuzz_real.sh; then docker run --rm --cpus=4 --memory=8g -e RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.86.0 -e CRUST_IMAGE=crust-vert-toolchain-x86 -e CRUST_ARTIFACT_COMMIT=40bc85c3b0d8f01e278c3c2e5b4a442b57cc1513 -e STARTUP_DIAG=work/arxiv_vert_fuzz30_work/startup_crash_diag.json -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work crust-vert-toolchain-x86 python3 -I systems/vert/bolero_vacuity/fuzz_real_classify.py work/arxiv_vert_fuzz30_work results/arxiv_vert_fuzz30_real.json arxiv_fuzz30_provenance.json
fuzz_command_per_function: cd <copy of artifacts/vert/benchmark/c_transcoder/<F>/out-rwasm-bolero, target/ left out, + benchmark/rust-toolchain.toml> && RUSTFLAGS='-C overflow-checks=false' cargo bolero test bolero_wasm_eq -T 30s  (subprocess timeout 1200 s; cargo-bolero 0.9 defaults: libfuzzer engine, -Zsanitizer=address, release, per-input -timeout=10, libFuzzer seed random and recorded per attempt)
same_as_check_current_fuzz_30s: same image, toolchain install, cargo-bolero fork rev, command, RUSTFLAGS, project copy and rust-toolchain.toml placement; NOT run: plant()
differences_from_check_current_fuzz_30s: no plant(): main.rs, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, guest_mem_wrapper.rs byte-identical to the artifact (sha256 per row)
subprocess timeout 1200 s instead of 600 s

start-up crash retry: an attempt whose test binary never reached libFuzzer and that ended non-zero without 'Test Failure' is re-run on the same copy (build reused), up to 4 more times; every attempt is kept
crate-rename diagnostic (not counted) on 'File name too long' compile errors, as rename_diag_current.sh

4 workers in one container (--cpus 4, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1) instead of 3 workers at --cpus 3; SHARED_TARGET/CARGO_TARGET_DIR is set but cargo-bolero builds under <project>/target/fuzz/build_<hash> anyway (as in check_current.py), so every function was built from scratch

startup_crash_diagnostic_command: same container (arxiv_vertfuzz) after the workers: apt-get install file; copy of NTH_PENTAGONAL_NUMBER/out-rwasm-bolero to /tmp/diag_p + rust-toolchain.toml; RUSTFLAGS='-C overflow-checks=false' cargo bolero test bolero_wasm_eq -T 1s (only to build the test binary; output not kept); python3 -I systems/vert/bolero_vacuity/startup_crash_diag.py work/arxiv_vert_fuzz30_work/startup_crash_diag.json 100 /tmp/diag_p/target (an earlier call on the workers' SHARED_TARGET dirs found no binaries, since cargo-bolero builds inside each deleted project copy; its minimal-program counts, 19/100 start-up SIGSEGV for asan_pie_default, 0/100 for the other two, were overwritten by this call)
seeds: one fuzz run per function (plus start-up-crash retries), libFuzzer seed random per attempt (recorded); another seed can give another input or outcome
